title: Human Reference Genome (GRCh38)
description: The human reference genome GRCh38 is the public composite reference assembly for Homo sapiens — built from multiple anonymous donors, not any one person's DNA — spanning about 3.1 billion base pairs across 22 autosomes plus X, Y, and mitochondrial DNA, with roughly 41% GC content. It is maintained by the Genome Reference Consortium and distributed as NCBI RefSeq accession GCF_000001405.40. This record carries a coded teaching model derived from its published statistics, never any individual's genetic data.
demo:
import random
random.seed(3801)
length, gc = 3_100_000_000, 0.41
print('GRCh38: ~3.1 Gb, GC ~41%, GCF_000001405.40')
print('coded teaching model (NOT real bases):', ''.join(random.choice('ACGT') for _ in range(60)))
print('composite public reference; no individual data')
provenance: Public reference: NCBI RefSeq / GenBank public reference assemblies (ncbi.nlm.nih.gov); verified 2026-10-21.
